native_runtime_proof.closed_exclusion: The compiled consoleAdmin default includes admin:*, kms:* and s3:*; it cannot match the original narrow policy hash and exact closed action/resource set. Thus accepted self policies exclude root and the active AuthZ-plugin branch at observation time, including legacy OPA using that same pointer. Original named GetUserInfo separately refuses temporary/service users, LDAP-mode missing enabled status, group memberships and policy-name drift. Parent AccountName substitution refuses.
native_runtime_proof.hidden_or_embedded_group_paths: AccountInfo's default branch includes actual cred.Groups and current PolicyDBGet merges group mappings. Any additional effective policy changes the exact canonical original policy hash or falls outside the closed set and refuses. This does not assert all groups or external identities are globally disabled.
native_runtime_proof.policy_hash_provenance: The expected hash is from the independently installed ORIGINAL signed permission-owner grant (observer hash from its independent startup source), already checked against the actual named policy. It is never computed from an uploaded/effective response and treated as an original authority pin. The narrow profile requires native normalized single-policy serialization to equal that original hash; incompatible policy IDs or merged forms refuse.
native_runtime_proof.limits: This proves a bounded current policy observation for the finite selected credentials, not future operation success, protection against a compromised server or an atomic transaction across all native requests. official_source_chain.locus: madmin v3.0.109 and pkg/v3 v3.1.0 dependencies
AccountInfoHandler; GetUserInfo; InfoCannedPolicy. Native current account/policy branch described above.
AccountInfo(ctx, AccountOpts{}) uses this exact GET and decodes unencrypted JSON; current DTO fields

IsAllowed checks the same current AuthZ pointer before root/STS/service/regular policy branches; Init builds plugin with legacy OPA fallback, then IAM store. Regular requests use PolicyDBGet + GetCombinedPolicy.

GetUserInfo rejects temporary/service accounts in built-in mode; non-built-in branch omits enabled status. PolicyDBGet includes cache mappings and credential groups; MergePolicies loads current cached policies.
Compiled DefaultPolicies consoleAdmin contains all admin, KMS and S3 rights, independent of an IAM named policy with the same name
MergePolicies clones statements, removes duplicates, drops document ID; IsAllowed evaluates Deny, then owner/Allow. Unsupported or changed merged serialization is refused by this candidate.
checkKeyValid identifies actual root and derived credentials; current effective self policy discriminates the root branch directly

findings: IAM Init snapshots globalServerConfig and sets current AuthN/AuthZ pointers; its AuthZ fallback includes legacy OPA. Init runs after initial config loading.

Reporting get-config-kv clones globalServerConfig, not simply the persisted configuration. Identity/policy subsystems are absent from SubSystemsDynamic. Regular config writes and IDP writes save storage and dynamically apply only listed subsystems.
Reporting env fields are generated from standard subsystem keys. Legacy OPA LookupConfig checks EnvIamOpaURL first; this path cannot be inferred absent from standard reporting alone.

loadEnvVarsFromFiles can load MINIO_CONFIG_ENV_FILE and call os.Setenv before server initialization. Linux proc environ only exposes initial execve environment, not later mutations; reading it alone would still be incomplete.

Therefore a config signature, Pod Env list, process uptime, restart annotation or isolated proc environ hash is insufficient on its own. An exhaustive startup-only proof would additionally need all environment transformations, persisted metadata, pointer writers and activation causality. This batch avoids claiming that proof and uses the actual current native runtime branch instead.
startup_and_reload_audit.controlled_activation_decision: No restart, image upgrade, credential reset, pods/exec privilege or new target provider is required merely to observe this exact native branch. If the installed server cannot be independently matched to this upstream profile, audit its actual version before porting the source, or explicitly provision a separately authorized controlled provider. Do not relabel an unknown/forked server or reset an existing provider to make it fit. No activation/restart action or command was executed or added.
